version.note: The recording documentation does not identify the original scoring or the revision with clarinets, nor a performing edition. The orchestra guide uses only shared instrumental families.

performers.note: Commons names Musopen Symphony; the upstream FLAC entry names Czech National Symphony Orchestra. A relationship between project credit and ensemble name is possible but not documented. No conductor is supplied.

date.note: 2012 is the release/project date. A separate recording-session date is not established.

place.note: Neither the Commons description nor the upstream collection identifies a recording venue.

label.note: Publisher/project credit, not an identified physical record label.

catalogue.note: No carrier catalogue number is supplied.

matrixTakeSides.note: The digital distribution does not establish any matrix, take or earlier physical carrier.

credits.note: No recording or transfer engineer is identified; the uploader is not assumed to be the engineer.

processing.note: The source is a FLAC file and the selected stream is its Wikimedia MP3 derivative. Restoration, equalisation and original capture settings are not established from the documentation consulted.

composition.note: Commons separates the expired composition copyright from the recording dedication; Mozart died in 1791.

recording.note: Commons explicitly applies the Musopen release to the sound recording. The Public Domain Mark is descriptive; it is not treated as an independent licence or as proof derived from the composition’s age.

rights.creditLine: Musopen Symphony (Commons credit); Czech National Symphony Orchestra (upstream credit; attribution unresolved). Musopen Kickstarter Project, via Internet Archive and Wikimedia Commons. Public-domain dedication attributed to Musopen.
